title: AIEOS conformance attestation payload
description: Canonical payload of a conformance attestation — the claim that an adapter version has satisfied a specific capability contract version by running the corresponding conformance suite and passing. Produced by the M4 conformance test harness on pass; a fail produces a diagnostic report instead, never an attestation. The payload is wrapped and signed per the sign.attestation contract; the signed wrapper validates against findings/schemas/oci-signing-bundle.schema.json (this schema describes the unsigned content).

subject.description: What the attestation is about — the adapter claiming conformance.

adapter_version.description: Semantic version of the adapter being attested.

predicate.description: What is being claimed — conformance to a specific contract version.

contract_id.description: Capability contract identifier — a taxonomy action.

contract_version.description: Semantic version of the contract the attestation was tested against.

suite_run_id.description: Unique identifier for the conformance suite run that produced this attestation. UUID or equivalent (minimum 16 characters).

result.description: Conformance outcome. Only 'pass' is valid — failures never produce an attestation.

signing_identity.description: Identity that signed the wrapping bundle. Typically an OIDC subject URI (e.g., a GitHub Actions workflow identity) or a named key identifier.

timestamp.description: Time the attestation was issued, ISO 8601 with timezone.
